AUTHOR: Bonofiglio, F; De Leo, FC; Yee, C; Chatzievangelou, D; Aguzzi, J; Marini, S
TITLE: Machine learning applied to big data from marine cabled observatories: A case study of sablefish monitoring in the NE Pacific
REGION: Barkley Canyon, NEPTUNE cabled observatory (Ocean Networks Canada), NE Pacific, 420-985 m
DATA: ONC NEPTUNE observatory video, 3 sites, Sep 2019-Feb 2020 (9772 five-minute clips, ~650 h); 3647 annotated frames
V_EV: Discussion: 'a depth gradient (420-970 m) which generally translates into variable regimes of seafloor detritus input and suspended particulate matter'; Table 1 depths and LED lights
D2: 2917 train / 730 test frames; 5-fold CV within training/validation
D_EV: Results 3.1: 'The manual annotation produced a total of 9205 tagged unique sablefish individuals distributed in 3647 image-frames, used for training (n = 2917) and testing (n = 730)'
R_EV: Abstract/Results: 'obtain an automatic detector with a 92% Average Precision (AP) on 730 test images' (all data from the same three ONC sites/period)
C_EV: Sec. 3.2: 'filtering only detections with the confidence value returned by YOLO greater or equal than 80% for the Node and Axis sites and 95% for Slope'; higher value 'needed to better discriminate'
E_EV: Sec. 2.6/3.3: 'validated the machine-learning results against independent visual counts manually obtained via the widespread MaxN estimation method'; 'measured 88% and 81% Pearson correlation'
ARCH: YOLOv5 + centroid Euclidean-distance tracker for counting
METR: AP@0.5, precision, recall, 5-fold CV AP; Pearson correlation of count time series with manual MaxN
NOTE: Split unit not stated; frames selected randomly from video clips (Table 1 footnote) and split by counts -> 이미지/프레임 무작위. Remaining 6125 clips (not used for training) used for count validation, but headline detector metrics come from frame split. Per-site thresholds (0.80/0.95) justified -> C_ALL=P. Tracking used to reduce multiple counts, plus sensitivity analysis of track-loss parameter m and manual spot checks of counts >100; not coded as C5 (no measured FP/duplicate rate) - verifier may consider C5 '중복계수(ID switch) 처리' which would make C_ALL=Y. Manual MaxN from 30-s clips of the same videos -> same-footage reference despite authors calling it 'independent'.
